facts.fact: Expresso das Ilhas reports the Justice Information System (SIJ) was developed by NOSi in partnership with the Ministry of Justice, with modules for first instance and the Relation courts.

CPV.note: SIJ is ordered into use at Polícia Nacional services from 30 January 2025, after the article date; no station record in use is stated.
